package rulefixtures

import (
	gorm "gorm.io/gorm"
)

// scenario for lower_or_func_wrapped_indexed_column: LOWER() or other functions wrapping indexed columns in WHERE clauses, preventing index usage.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: data_access; severity: contextual.

type User struct {
	ID    int
	Email string
	Name  string
}

func FindByEmail(db *gorm.DB, email string) (*User, error) {
	var user User
	err := db.Where("LOWER(email) = ?", email).First(&user).Error
	return &user, err
}

func SearchByName(db *gorm.DB, name string) ([]User, error) {
	var users []User
	err := db.Where("UPPER(name) LIKE ?", "%"+name+"%").Find(&users).Error
	return users, err
}
